problem_frame: Ideas are fragmented and difficult to compare over time
Hidden assumptions distort selection and implementation
Ideas are evaluated too narrowly under present conditions
Ideas are overcommitted before evidence is generated
Idea portfolios lack review cadence and accountability
Affected stakeholders lack structured voice in evaluation
Selected ideas are not translated into sequenced pathways
Ideas ignore feedback loops delayed effects and unintended consequences
Rejected options and rationale are lost after decisions
Ideas are listed without being classified by strategic function
Selection criteria are implicit inconsistent or politically shaped
Feedback from pilots is collected but not converted into revised strategy
